name: Intoxicant
source:
You play as a bartender on a lonely night, when a very pretty lady lends you her company, her life story, and maybe even more if you make her the right drinks ;) But don't worry, there are no wrong answer here!

[From [url=https://hotpink.itch.io/intoxicant]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个孤独的夜晚，你扮演一名调酒师，一位非常漂亮的女士向你借用她的陪伴，她的生活故事，如果你为她调制合适的饮料，甚至可能提供更多；）但别担心，这里没有错误的答案！

[来自[url=https://hotpink.itch.io/intoxicant]Itch.io[/url]]
